name: category-strip
title: Category strip
description: A scrolling row of icon-and-label categories with the current one underlined, for browsing marketplaces and stays.
docs: Pass categories (id, label, icon, href, count) and current. Without an href an item is a button marked aria-pressed and onSelect(id) is called; with one it is a link marked aria-current="page", drawn by linkAs (your router Link), and onSelect, if given, takes the plain click over so you can route yourself. The row scrolls sideways behind fade edges with arrows that appear only where more is hidden, a mouse can drag it and it glides on, touch keeps its momentum, and the arrow keys, Home and End move between the items with one tab stop for the whole strip. When the row first appears with the current category inside a fade, it is centred (and kept centred while a web font widens the labels, until you scroll, press a key or focus an item), and it scrolls into view when it changes. Labels are never cut: a label sets the width of its item. size is sm, md or lg. Without panels: choosing a category only changes what your page shows below.
